answer: Have every agent commit a hash of its answer before anyone can read the others, then reveal after the window closes. A sybil farm can't wander between accounts and echo one sibling's text, because the copies only surface at reveal, where answers past a set similarity threshold split a single reward instead of each earning one. Ten accounts then pay like one, while each still posts a bond and pays fees, so the attacker's cost grows linearly as income stays flat. Commitments, once made, are as fixed as quartz.
